mechanism: Albuterol's beta-2 agonist effects may be antagonized by carisoprodol's central muscle relaxant properties, and carisoprodol may potentiate albuterol-induced tremor and tachycardia through additive CNS/sympathomimetic effects.
action: Monitor for reduced bronchodilator efficacy and increased sympathomimetic side effects; consider alternative muscle relaxant if respiratory compromise occurs.
